audit.why: Taliyah bullies pre-6 at 1000 range; Talon takes over at 6 and first lethality item; Taliyah outscales late with E/wall spacing. Content layer already tells this and matches the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart said Talon x4 / Skill / Skill / Talon — nearly the inverse of content win[] and the packet (Taliyah 1-5, Talon at 6 and first item, Taliyah 2+ items).
audit.why: Content and packet agree row-for-row and the content whys are kit-grounded (he cannot all-in profitably pre-6; R-W-Q flips it at 6; late spacing wins). Full sides moved to match, whys rewritten, ratings adjusted. Packet defect about 5/7 Taliyah stages vs 47.94% WR is explained by the Talon stages being the kill windows.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides now match win[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; W-displacement-vs-dash and E-mine-vs-Q-jump interactions unstated in full layer; two pasted trade strings under Do's/Don'ts titles.
audit.why: Rake is 9s at rank 1, Shadow Assault 100/80/60s, his Q jump only reaches 575 — all shorter than Taliyah's 1000-range Q. Her W mid-dash breaks his combo and knocking him through E mines stuns him.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with digits; the displacement and mine interactions written into Do's/Don'ts and whys.

edits.before: Talon wins by landing Rake, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Talon wins by hitting 6, Q-jumping through your stones, and converting Rake plus his bleed into a one-combo deletion.

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Q on fresh ground outranges everything Talon has at level 1 — he cannot reach you without eating stones the whole way in.

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: shove him straight back if he Q-jumps in — the 575-range leap is his only opener.

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: E-detonate his jump for the stun — his W poke loses to your 1000-range Q, so zone him off every last-hit.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave; he can't all-in profitably before 6, so bank a health lead while it's safe.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: His R-W-Q combo is lethal from 6 — shove him under tower, hold Worked Ground to escape, and roam only where he's seen.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: His first lethality item lands before your Luden's matters — never sit low in his 575 Q jump range with his Ignite up.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late you flip it: E-detonation and Weaver's Wall create distance his single-target dive can't cross. Peel and outscale.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Check it before every step-up. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Rake (9s rank 1): the boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line and trade in its downtime. - Shadow Assault runs 100/80/60s; while it's down his all-in is a bluff. - Your W (14s) is the lifeline.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: The instant he Q-jumps or R-dashes at you, W-shove him back out — the displacement breaks the combo and knocks him through your E mines for the stun.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: Melee range is where his Q crits and Blade's End stacks bleed — with no W to shove him off, that trade is his kill script.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP feeds the roam plan and wins the reset war; Ignite matches his all-in threat at 6. Pick by how hard you roam.

notes: Packet defect 'chart contradicts 47.94% WR' judged not a defect: Taliyah holds more stages but Talon's two stages (6, first item) are the kill windows that decide games. Full sides moved alone — content win[] already matched packet on every row. Content layer is matchup-specific and healthy; untouched.
